name: Washington caselaw — Caselaw Access Project — 1931–1978 (part-0002)
description: 18778 historical CAP case records, selected by CAP's jurisdiction label. Part of Washington caselaw — Caselaw Access Project; see the collection index for complete coverage. Preserves CAP's Washington jurisdiction assignment: 41,045 Supreme Court records, 65,131 Court of Appeals records under four source court labels, and one historical Washington District Court record. Includes territorial-era records and upstream dates from 1854 through 2019. Coverage reflects the pinned historical archive, not every decision issued by those courts. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.
